In a silent room in the middle of the fleet, a wolf-head Master broke from his meditation and opened his eyes, facing up his fatal enemy.

At the moment, a graceful young lady was standing at the end of the corridor, like a sharp sword unleashing from its sheath. Countless spots of light encircled her, like stars breathing and dancing in the cosmos. If you look closer, you may find that the light spots are sealed in a translucent jar, like shrines immured on walls.

"These Core Esse..." The wolf-head Master uttered, "So they are what you obtained from the divine relic."

"The Master of Immortality only granted us power, but cultivated the seed of the sacred tree in you. How unfair..."

"I put thirty thousand people to death and had the anatomist dissect their live Core Esse for these Esse Shrine. I've made further studies of them."

"My studies have proven me right. The heart is for the sake of sustaining life, and Core Esse is to absorb power from the root. This organ is much more important than the heart. It can be regarded as the 'engine' of the body."

"Now I am using them to propel this fleet, using their organs to destroy their own alliance!"

The wolf-head man lifted off the gorgeous mantle that covered his chest, and revealed a jellyfish-like translucent armor coating his bulging muscles. He inhaled deeply, as if he could consume all the air within this narrow space. In seconds, his hunched body expanded muscle by muscle, and turned into a huge iron tower of flesh. The cracking bones and warping flesh generated a sharp and painful noise during the deformation, and quickly healed.

The wolf-head man has long been used to these pains. As he breathed, a weak glimmer of light overflowed from his mouth, nose, eyes, and ears. His Core Esse started to shine brightly.

"This armor fits well my blood and flesh. It is like it were an organ attached to my body. However, its prowess is yet to be tested."

"My opponents have all turned into balls of flesh with just one blow. Maybe the High-Cloud Quintet can help me know its true limit!"

The lady's eyes were as dark and cold as ice, as if the things happening in front of her were dull and uninteresting.

Thirty thousand soldiers, thirty thousand Core Esse that are kindles of life... She tried not to get distracted by the cruelty of the miracle before her eyes.

The subtle balance between the two sides is hard to maintain. One would take their advantage precisely when they get the chance. The wolf-head man soared forward as a mass of gray storm.

In the next heartbeat, the lady disappeared. The spot she stood before was only left with a sharp footprint. With a flicker of a sword flash, comes a loud sonic boom...

...

Looks like I've got a grasp on what's going on,
I didn't physically enter this world.
I might just be a ghost,
A ghost named "Rosy Celestial Maiden,"
...hope I don't scare anyone.

These days, no one can see me directly,
and I can't meddle in anything either.
Just like a "memetic" entity Black Swan was talking about,
but I must have left some traces behind, right?
...Otherwise, who do they think they're talking about when they mention the "Rosy Celestial Maiden"?

I remembered the day I ran into that red-haired girl.
She was praying in a secret chamber:
"I have accepted the mission. I have to set out..."
Surely, it must have been something very important,
"Mom... see you tomorrow."
Just going with my gut, I followed after her.
Sure enough, she was stopped by unreasonable guards.

But what can someone like me possibly do?
... I want to help her on her journey more than anything.
Just stand by and watch? Not a chance!
Hey, even "memetic entities" have our own special talents!
I could be her shield! Or maybe her spear!
Heck, I could even be a crumbled pillar...

"Is the Titan... on her side?"
Ha! Wrong answer! It's ME who's on her side!
...If only I could actually show up in front of her.
Just imagine how much more I could do for her.

"Finally... beyond this gate awaits a boundless world."
"This is where my journey begins."
She made it.
But as a memetic entity... I'm completely worn out.
...When I came to, I was somewhere totally different.

"She won't remember you. You won't leave a trace in anyone's memories..."
I think I heard another me speaking.
Am I going crazy?
I should be fine! I can't even imagine what it'd be like if I actually lost my marbles...

But hey, I totally left a trace.
She might not remember me, but she successfully started her journey now.
That "rather illogical outcome" on the day her journey began was my mark.
Just like the Rosy Celestial Maiden.
Amphoreus might not remember me, but the legend of the Rosy Celestial Maiden is everywhere in this land.

I'm not throwing in the towel yet.
Someday, everyone in Amphoreus will know exactly who the Rosy Celestial Maiden really is!
